# System Maturity — common

Shared types and utilities used by the System Maturity frontend and backend packages.

**npm package:** `@vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity-common`  
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity-common.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity-common)

Consumers usually install `backstage-plugin-system-maturity` and `backstage-plugin-system-maturity-backend`; add **common** explicitly if your bundler or TypeScript setup needs a direct dependency.

```bash
yarn add @vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity-common
```

## Contents

Place types, constants, and helpers here that are shared by the `frontend/` and `backend/` packages of this plugin.
